TITLE: Ki Mrad Khlaw Ka Meghalaya AUTHOR: Laloo, Shining Star YEAR: 2014 ID: ki_mrad_khlaw_ka_meghalaya_464927 ------------------------------------------------------------ c UK Da V Shining Star Laloo Shikyntien arkyntten Shaphang U Nongthoh U (Td) 1 Shining Star Laloo u dei u khun ba-ar napdeng ki laingut shipara - Ka hynmen Kong Waila Deborah Laloo bad u para (Td) Irwin Laloo jong u (Td) Meklin Roy Majaw bad ka (Td) Nezarley Laloo. La kha Ya u ha ka 20 tank Kyllalyngkot jong ka snem 1949. U la leit skul ha Jowai Presbyterian Primary School, Mission Compound, Jowai. U la pyndep Ya ka Class XU na Jowai Government Multipurpose School. U pass Ya ka B.A. (Political Science) na St. Anthony's College, Shillong bad Ya ka M.A. (Pol. Sc) na Gauhati University, Assam. U trei nyngkong ha D.I.P.R.O. Jowai. U leit training Journalist sha Delhi. Hadien katta u join kum (Sr.) Information Officer ha kajuh ka Office. Shisnem shwa ba un shongthait, u Yoh promotion kum u Deputy Director ha D.I.P.R.O . Shillong. Hadien ka jingjia ha ka 28 tank u Nohprah 2011, kata kumba shi snem hadien, nga la kwah ban pyndep noh Ya kane ka kot bad ban pynmih noh Ya ka. Nga diaw ka mynsiem bad ngam tip kumno ban sdang. Nga nguh Ya U Trai Kynrad, U Nongbuh Nongthaw ban Yarap bad ai mynsiem Ya nga ban lah ban pyndep Ya kiei kiei kiba u la hap ban iehnoh shiteng namar bym shah shuh ka por Ya u. Ki hynmen ki para jong nga ruh ki Yai kyntiew ba nga dei ban pynkloi Ya ka kam khnang ba ki jingtrei shitom jong u la 20 snem (Research work) kin nym sep ei bad kin sei Ya u soh babang. Ha kane ka por kaba khim, nga phai khmat nyngkong sha u Ma S. Quotient Sumer - u paralok Yajan bha bad u Nongthoh. Kumba nga kyrmen, u Ma Sumer u khlem kyntait, u kioi ban Yarap bad batai kumno ban leh. Dei u Ma Sumer uba wad Ya u nongpule bad pynbeit Ya ka Manuscript u Ma D. Michael Buam bad u ban leh Ya kiei kiei kiba hap ban leh haduh ban print ha ka Press. Ha kane ka kot, ngam lah ban thoh pyntam ne ban ot noh hynrci la phah shon thik kumba u Nongthoh u la dep pynbiang nadong shadong. Haduh ki dur jong ki mrad baroh kat kiba u lah ban Yoh lum bad shon dur Ya ki mrad ruh kiba u Yoh. Dangbun ki jingangnud jong u ban thoh ban pynseisoh Ya ka Bn ka Thoh ka Tar u Hynfiiew Trep Hynfiiew Skum.

Nga khmih lynti ba kiei kiei kiba Yadei bad kane ka kot baroh kin long kiba Yaid beit laid ryntih kumba u Nongthoh u phohsniew. Kane ka kot “Ki Mrad Khlaw Ka Meghalaya” ka dei ka kot kaba saw kaba u la pynmih hadien jong ka (1) Behdeinkhlam, (2) Ka Syiem La Tympang bad (3) U Joh Ymbon. Na ka liang jong nga kum ka nongrap pateng Ya kiei kiba u la iehnoh shadien nga ai khublei kyrpang Ya kito baroh kiba la Yarap Ya u Nongthoh kumba u la dep ai khublei lypa ha ka lynnong kaba khadduh ha kane ka kot. U la iehnoh shadien Ya ka Lok, Ka Kong Lammi Pde bad lai ngut ki khun kynthei. Khublei Shibun, Chihajar Nguh. Ka Lok jong u Nongthoh, Ka Kong Lammi Pde. 1 (Td) Kaba thoh lyngkot Ya ka ktien Tynrawde lane Tynde. Ha ka Ktien Pnar, Tynrawde/Tynde ka mut Bam kwai ha dwar u Blei. Ka ktien Tynde bunsien ngi pyndonkam haba Yakren. 3 KA LAMPHRANG Ka pynsngewrit shisha Ya nga haba nga pule Ya kane ka kot namarba ka dei hok ban dawa Ya ka burom na kiba ieid Ya ka jingstad bad jingtip, bad, katba nga dang thoh Ya kane ka lamphrang, ka mih ka jingsngewbabe ha lade, namarba ngan ym Yohlad ban Yasyllok bad Yaphylliew jingmut bad une u nongthoh na ka daw ba u Blei u la khot Ya u sha ka ri u khyndai trep khyndai skum. Nga pdiang, ba kane ka dei ka mon jong u Kynrad, ba nga la Yoh lad ban maitphang Ya kane ka kot jong u (Tynrawde) Shining Star Laloo. Ha ka jingpeit bad ka jingsngew jong nga, kane ka kot ka dei ka synfliang kaba khraw ha ka liang ka thoh ka tar bad ka pule puthi ha ka ktien jong ngi hi ki khun u hynfliewtrep. Nga ong khnang Ya kane, namarba, ka jaitbynriew jong ngi kam duna ha ka stad ka tip lada ngi kren Ya ka juk barim ne ka juk bathymmai. Ka jingiapher hapdeng ka juk barim bad kaba thymmai ka dei halor ka jingpyndonkam Ya kane ka stad ka tip. Ha ka juk barim, ki kmie bad kpa tymmen jong ngi ki la pyndonkam Ya ka stad ka tip jong ki na ka bynta ka lawei ki nongpateng jong ki, katba ha kane ka juk bathymmai pat bun kiba pyndonkam Ya ka na ka bynta ka mynta jong ki. Ngan shu kdew Ya ka nuksa jong ki Lawkyntang, ki Law Raid bad ki Law Lyngdoh kiba ki longshwa jong ngi ki la buh la seng na ka bynta jong ngi. Nga sngewkmen bad sngewsarong, ba une u nongthoh u la bud Ya ka nuksa ki longshwa jong ngi. Ka jingkiew ha ka jingriewspah, ka jingYar bad ka jingYaineh ka ktien jong kano kano ka jaitbynriew ka shong ha ki jingthoh ba mih na ka, bad, ka dei ruh ban kham mih na ki khun jong ka hi, khnang ba ki jingthoh, ki lah ban pynmih bad pynpaw Ya ki jingmut jong ki, katkum ka mynsiem jong ka riti ka dustur jong kata ka jaitbynriew. Bad dei hangne ba ka khyndcw ka dang sah shrah namarba dang duna ki nongrep ha kane ka lyngkha ka thoh ka tar ha ka ktien Khasi. Kine ki nongrep kiba la leit bad kiba mynta, ki la pynmih ki jingthoh shaphang ki jingjia ba la dep ne ki khanapateng, ki sawangka, ki kot Yathuhkhana, ki jingrwai, ki puriskam bad ki khanatang, ki phawer bad ki jingthoh shaphang ka niam, ka dustur bad ka riti ka jaitbynriew jong ngi. Hadien shisnem, uta u juh u Hati sawkuna u la wan poi biang sha shnong Umladang, bad u la pynjot thiaw Ya kwei ka Ying u Khar- khuti Ya uba ki ju khot ieid u "Kansha” Mar Ya dep pynjot Ya kata ka Ying, uta u Hati u la phet noh shapoh khlaw bad namar ba ka dei ka por tlang bad ka la long ka por janmiet kumta ka la sdang ban dum kloi. Ha ka step kaba bud, u Ma Dwor bad amgut ki paralok jong u, ki la leit buddien Ya uta u Hati bad ki la rah ruh ar tylli ki suloi rifle. Hadien ba ki la Yaid khamslen bad ynda ki poi ha kawei ka jaka kaba don ha ka phud wah jong ka wah Mynkhen, ki la Yohi Ya uta u Hati ba u Yeng harud jong uwei u dieng Sase, bad, ba u dang kyrshut Ya ka met jong u ha uta u dieng. Namarba jur than u phlang ba jrong bad ki sder ruh ki la jrong, kumta ym long shuh ban siat na kata ka jaka ba ki la Yohi Ya uta u Hati. Kumta, ki la par sor sor narud jong ki sder bad ynda ki poi hajan jong u Hati, ki la Yohsngew ba u dang pynhiar mynsiem phia phia. Ki la peit na khap ki sder bad ki la Yohi ba uta u Hati u don tang kumba shiphew pruh ei-ei na kaba ki don. Hangta hi, baroh ar ngut ki thew Ya ki rifle jong ki sha uta u Hati bad ki la siat lang jling ha kajuh ka por. Uta u Hati u la kyllon khram ha madan bad kita ki sder pat ki la tap Ya ki. Ki la Ya-mut ba ki la shah ban ha u Hati, hynrei ym dei kumta. Tang shiphang, uta u Hati u la Yeng biang, bad bat da u luta jong u Ya uta u dieng Sase. Kumta ki la thep kuli bad siat biang Ya uta u Hati. Hynrei, um shym la kyllon bad u la Yaid sha khmat bad ki nil ki la buddien biang Ya u. Haha ki la Yaid tang khyndiat, u Bah Dwor u la ong, “Ban buddien kumnete ka long kaba mynsaw, Ya ngin pom pakhet nangne.” Tang hadien shipor ki la Yohi biang Ya uta u Hati ba u la Yeng ha trai jong uwei u diengsning, uba don ki tnad haduh hajan trai dieng. U Bah Dwor u I a Tathuh ba lada ki buddien beit Yau, uta u Hati un jin da la Yoh ban pynhiar kput Ya k i . Uta u hati u Yeng bad bat da u luta jong u ha uta u diengsning khnang ba un nym kyllon. Hangne ruh ki la siat biang sa ar kuli Ya u Hati, hynrei u khlem kyllon.

Dei da ka jingsted jong kiban thep kuli ba ki la siat Ya uta u Hati haduh 14 kuli hynrei um kyllon satia. Te, namar ba la miet bad ba dei ka por tlang, kumta ki la leit phai noh sha la ki jong ki Ying ki sem. Ha ka step kaba bud ki la pynkhie paidbah na ki lai tylli ki shnong ba marjan bad kita ki dei ka shnong Umladang, ka shnong Rakabah bad ka shnong Kdiap. Kane ka la jia ha u snem 1965. Ynda ki 18 Kl MRAD KHLAW KA MEGHALAYA la poi ha uta u diengsning, u Had um don shuh. Hynrei, ki la Yohi Ya ka snam ba lang lai saw jaka ha madan. Na kane ka jaka ki bud beit Ya ka snam ba la jaw bad lang ha lynti haduh ba kin da poi ha ka jaka ba ki khot ka Madan Umprang. Bun ha kane ka madan don ka snam ba lang lynnong lynnong shi jaka jaka, kaba la mih ha ka por ba uta u Hati u la dem ha kita ki jaka. Harud kane ka madan don ka khar um kaba heh bha, ha kaba ki Hati ha ki por mynshwa ki ju sum sngewbha barabor. Dei hapoh kata ka khar um ba ki la lap Ya ka met Yap jong uta u Hati. Ki bniat jong uta u hati ruh, ki long kiba la kdiah bad sah sa tang ki tyndo bniat (ki trai bniat). Kumta ki la thlieh da u side bad sei Ya kita ki trai bniat, bad ki la Yasam mar khyndiat Ya kita ki trai bniat. Baroh lai shnong ki la kit Ya ka doh jong uta u Hati haduh ar sngi sha la ki Ying ki sem. Ki la shet katto katne ka doh ban Yoh ban bam noh Ya ka. la kaba bun pat ki thad tyrkhong Ya ka, bad ki sa bam pat Ya ka hadien. U Bah Dwor u la Yathuh ruh ba ka Pynthor Sung ka la long mynshwa kaba jyllei bha ki mrad ki mreng kum ki Hati, ki Khla, ki Sier, ki Skei, ki Bthong, ki Dngeim bad ki mrad rit babun jait lem bad ki sim ki doh ba laiphew jait. Hapoh ka Pynthor Sung ba Yar bad ba khraw, don ruh lai tylli ki um bluh (Um mluh) bad kita ki long ka um Mluh Mynri, ka um Mluh Dhar bad ka Um Mluh Ktieh. Ha ki por ba mynshwa, ki mrad ba bun jait, ki ju leit dih um mluh na kine ki um mluh man ka sngi. Hynrei, mynta pat ba ki khlaw ki btap ki la fiiar bad duna bha, kumta, ki mrad, ba lait na ka jingshah pynYap pathar ha ki briew bad kiba la duh jaka shong jaka sah, ki la phet noh sha Karbi Anglong Districting ka jylla Assam. Mynta, hapoh ka pynthor Sung, sah sa tang ki mrad rit ba bunjait, ki sim ki doh ba har rukom bad ki kynja ba par bunjait. Ki jymbuifl jong ki Hati Kynthei ki don sha khmat, kata ha ka shadem jong ki, ym kumba long kiwei pat ki mrad sawkjat. Ki Hati ki ju Yapoikha da kaba thiah hapoh ka wah kaba jyndong ne ha ki jaka them ba don hapoh lawbah lawsan. Teng-khat pat, ki ju Yapoikha kumba Yapoikha ki Masi. Ka long ruh kaba kham fiiar ba ki briew kin Yohi Ya ka jingYapoikha jong ki. Ym tang katta, hynrei ka long ruh kaba ma ban lap ba ki dang Yapoikha namar, kin beh thong Ya u bnew shisyndon bad lada ki Yoh, kin pynYap beit Ya u. Namarkata, lada jia ryngkhat ba phi lap ba ki Hati ki dang Yapoikha, wat jam, wat hylla ne pynpaw Yalade, hynrei, Yaleh ban Yaid jar jar na kawei pat ka lynti.

Ha ka por ba ki Hati ki Yapoikha da kaba thiah, u Hati shynrang u ju syrpud Ya ki jumbuifi ka Hati da u luta jong u. Ka por Yapoikha jong ki Hati ka neh hapdeng shitaYew ne palat 15 sngi. Hadien ka jingYapoikha, u Hati shynrang u leit phai sha la ka kynhun, bad ka Hati kynthei ruh ka leit phai sha la ka kynhun. “Ka por pun khun jong ki Hati pat ka long kaba slem bha. Ka shim por haduh ba la jan dap arsnem, kata, hapdeng 19 bnai ne 22 bnai, bad ki kha khun ruh shisien saw snem. Ka Hati kynthei ka lah ban sdang kha khun naduh ba la dap 1 5 snem shaneng. Haba ka Hati ka la dei ban kha, ar ne lai tylli ki Hati kynthei kiba na kajuh ka kynhun, ki Yalam Ya ka Hati ban kha khun sha ka jaka ba kham pajih ne kynjah. Ka Hati ka kha Ya i khun da kaba Yeng, bad i khun i hap da ka khlieh shwa ha madan. ta ka kynja jingsop ba stang kum ka jar ba tap Ya ka met i khun Hati, la weng noh Ya ka da kawei na ki Hati ba Yarap ban pynkha ne da ka kmie jong ita i Hati hi. Dei ha ka por ba kha ba u thied sohpet uba bsa bam Ta i khun Hati bad kjit Ya ka jakhlia ba mih na i khun Hati ha ka por ba i dang don hapoh jong ka pla khun jong ka kmie jong i ba la bthat ne pyndkut noh Ya u. Ki Hati ba Yarap ban pynkha, ki Yarap ban pynYeng Ya i khun Hati bad Yalam Ya i sha ka jaka ba don ki jymbuifl jong ka kmie, khnang ba in Yoh ban buifl. Hadien katto katne por, ka nong kha, ki nongYarap pynkha, lem bad i khun Hati ba Yaid hapdeng jong ki, ki leit phai noh sha la ka kynhun. Ha ka por kha i khun Hati i lah ban khia 115 Kg ne tarn bad i khun Hati in buifi haduh lai snem tarn”, la kane ka bynta, une u Nongthoh u la Yohi bad tohsngew Ya ka jingbatai ha kawei na ki programme , ba la pyni ha ka Discovery Channel lyngba ka Television. HATI Ki Hati, haba ki kwah ban dcm ne haba don ki briew ba shong halor ka met jong ki bad kita ki nongshong ki kwah ban hiar noh, ki Mahut ki ai dak Ya ki Hati bad ki sa dem da kaba kyrshon shwa Ya ki khohsiew ba shadien jong ki ha madan, bad ki sa pynbeit ia ki kjat ba sha khmat jong ki ha madan, khnang ba ki briew kin suk ban hiar. Hynrei ynda ki Yeng, ki dei ban Teng shwa da ki kjat ba shakhmat jong ki bad ki sa pynYeng Ta ki kjat ba shadien jong ki, bad kumta ki sa lah ban leit kat sha ba ki kwah ban leit. la kane ka rukom Yeng bad dem jong ki Hati, une u Nongthoh u la Tohi bunsien haba ki Mahut ki pynhiar Ya ki khynnah ba Yoh Ta ka National Bravery Award \ kiba shong halor ki Hati ha ka por ba ki Ya shim bynta ha ka Republic Day Parade ha New Delhi ha ki snem 1977, 1984, bad 1998. U Bah S.B. Dohkrut u la Yathuh ha une u Nongthoh ba u la Yohi da la ki jongki khmat, kumno u Hati u Yaid ha ki jaka ba twa ka kyndew ( Landslide ) ha ka por ba u leit khwai ha ka Wah Lukha, kaba la jia la kham bun snem mynta. U Hati ha shwa ba un laid ha ka jaka twa ka khyndew, u la twad shwa Ya ka jaka ba u mut ban Yuh da u luta jong u, la ka long ne em kaba biang; haba u shem ba ka long kaba biang u buh Ya kawei ka kjat khmat jong u. Nangta u twad biang Ya ka khyndew da u luta jong u ha ka khyndew bad ynda u shem ba ka long kaba biang, u buh Ya kawei pat ka kjat khmat jong u. Ta ki kjat dien u rah kawei hadien kawei pat ha kito ki jaka ba u la buh shwa Ya ki kjat khmat jong u, u Yai twad Ya ka khyndew bad haba u shem ba ka long kaba biang u buh Ya ka kjat jong u ha kata ka jakabad u Yai leh Ya kane, haduh ba un da lait ban Yaid lyngba kata ka jaka ba twa ka kyndew. Ha ka por ba ki Phareng ki dang synshar Ya ka Jaintia Hills, ki Dkhar ki ju wan ban kher bad kern Ya ki Hati na ki khlaw jong ka Jaintia Hills da kaba siew Ya kabai Musur sha u S.D.O. (Civil) ha Jowai. Ha ka por ba ki ju Yalam Ya ki sha Jowai, ki ju teh Ya ki ha ka jaka ba ki khot “Kdoh-Hati”, kaba don hapoh ka dong Lulong. ta ki Hati ba la ri ki briew bad kiba ki pyndonkam ha kaba kem bad teh Ya ki Hati khlaw la khot Ya ki, ki “Winong” bad ha ka ktien Dkhar pat la khot Ya ki, ki “Kundi”, kaba mut ba ki long ki Hati ba la Yoh jinghikai. Khlem ki Winong, ka long kaba eh bha ban kem bad ban teh Ya ki Hati khlaw, wat la ki la ngat hapoh ka jingker, kaba la ker pynskhem bha da ki dieng tylli kiba heh, ba jwat bad ba eh. U Bah C.

Kharkongor u la Yathuh ha une u Nongthoh ba don ki Bhoi kiba stad bad tip bha shano ki Hati ne u Hati u don, tang da kaba kbum Ya ka shympriahti kdew jong ki hapoh ka shyntur, bad ki sa pynshah Ya ka ha ka Iyer bad kin sa Yathuh shano u Hati ne ki Hati ki don. Shisien, la bun phew snem mynta, uwei u Sahep uba ki khot u Sahep Ross, u la leit ban siat Ya uwei u Hati Sawkuna hajan ka shnong Jrikyndeng. Na Jrikyndeng, uwei u Bhoi u la Yalam lynti Ya u Sahep Ross, sha ka khlaw ba don uta u Hati. Ynda poi hapoh khlaw, uta u Bhoi u la kbum Ya ka kti kdew jong u hapoh la ka shyntur bad u sa pynshah Ya ka ha ka Iyer; tang shiphang u la Yathuh ba uta u Hati u don sha ka Hang ka diang. Kumta, u Sahep Ross ruh la leit shaphang ka diang kumba la pyni uta u Bhoi Ya u, ba don uta u Hati sha kata ka bang. Hynrei, haba u Sahep Ross u la laid tang katto katne por uta u Hati u la mih kynsan bluit bad beh thong Ya u Sahep Ross, uba ha ka jingbympoi pyrkhat bad ha ka jingkyrkieh u la march ruma, bad ha ka por ba u dang march u la kyllon ha madan. Uta u Hati ruh haba ym Yohi shuh Ya u Sahep Ross u la Yeng hajuh. Ha kata ka por u Sahep Ross u don hapoh ka jaka ba Yeng uta u Hati, tangba um shym la Yapler ne duh ka jingtip briew. Mar kumta hi u la buh Ya ka ktang jong ka rifle jong u hajan u klongsnam jong uta u Hati bad u la siat ar kuli, namar, kata ka rifle jong u ka long kaba lah ban siat bunsien. Mar kumta ka snam ka la tuid ha u Sahep Ross bad i la kumba pynsum Ya ubaroh shirynYeng ha ka snam. Uta u Hati ruh ula kyllon Yap harud kata ka jaka hi. Hynrei, donbok shibun ba u khlem ban Ya u Sahep Ross. Uta u Bhoi uba leit Yalam lynti Ya u Sahep Ross, ha kata ka por u la Yeng halor uwei u lum bad ula Yohi lut Ya kata ka jingjia bad ha ka por ba kyllon u Sahep Ross, u la mut ba ki sngi jong u Sahep Ross ki la kut hynrei, u la kmen bha haba u la 20 Kl MRAD KHLAW KA MEGHALAYA Tohi ba uta u Hati u la kyllon Tap. la kane ka jaka ha kaba u Sahep Ross u la Yoh ban siat pynYap Ya uta u Hati, haduh kine ki sngi la khot Ya ka ka jaka lait im u Sahep Ross. Ki Hati ba la ri ki briew ki long kiba ieid bad kohnguh Ya la ki kynrad, kiba shah pynkhyllew bad kiba Yaleh katba lah ban pynhun Ya la u kynrad. U Bah Webster Laloo, u la Yathuh ha une u Nongthoh ba la kham bun snem mynshwa u la Yohi ba uwei u Hati ba u tan Ya uwei u diengbah na kawei ka bri soh ba don ha thaifi War Jaintia. Namar ba uta u dieng u long ubaheh bha, kumta bunsien u la pyrshang ban rah Ya uta u dieng hynrei um lah satia. Kumta, u Mahut u la ong Ya uta u Hati uba kyrteng u Raja, “Raja sei la ka buit, ka bor bad lada me lah ban tan Ya une u dieng, te ynda poi ha Ying, ngan sa Yathuh ha ka Rani (Ka kyrteng ka kurim uta u Hati) Ya ka jingkhlaifl bor jong me bad kumta kan ieid bha Ya me”. Mar kumta hi uta u Hati u la sei lut Ya la ka bor bad u la lah ban tan Ya uta u dieng. U Mahut u la ong pat. “Shabas Raja! Me te uba khlaifi shisha”. Ki Hati ki long ki mrad ki bym ju lah ban shah Ya ka jingkrensih krensang bad Ya ka jingkrenbeifl Ya ki. La kham bun snem mynta, ka la jia ha ka shnong Mawryngkneng, ba wan pynialehkai Circus ki Dkhar. Ha kawei ka miet, katba ki dang pynlong Ya ka jingialehkai Circus Ya uwei u Hati, uwei u briew uba la buaid u la tim shi tim sang bad kren beift de Ya uta u Hati. Ha kata ka por uta u Hati u la sat bad dom bha bad u la mut ban tur sha uta u briew.

Hynrei, U Mahut um shah Ya u ban leh kumta bad ynda la kut ka jingialehkai Circus , la teh Ya uta u Hati da u kynjri nar habar. Ynda baroh ki nongpynialehkai Circus ki la thiah, uta u Hati u la pajut tyngeh Ya uta u kynjri bad u la dkut thui. Nangta, u la laid beit beit sha ka Ying ba shong uta u briew uba la tim sih tim sang bad kren beift Ya u. Ynda u la poi ha kata ka Ying, ha ka por shiteng synftia, katba uta u briew u dang Yashong kai bad ar ngut ki paralok jong u, uta u Hati u la rung ha Ying bad shim belt tang Ya uta uba la kren beift Ya u, bad u la lynthaw Ya u ha madan bad u sa iuh sa da ka kjat jong u na ka shadem uta u briew bad u la Yap ha shen. Nangta, u leit phai biang sha ka jaka ba la teh Ya u, bad ula dem hangta haduh ban da shai. Ki trai Circus kirn tip Ya kata ka jingjia ha kata ka miet, hynrei ki tip Ya ka ha ka por mynstep, haduh ban da Yathuh ki trai shnong Ya ki, bad ki sa lip ruh ba uta uba la shah pynYap u long u briew uba sniew. U Bah S.G. Momin, I.P.S. uba la ju long teng mynshwa u Superintendent of Police , Jaintia Hills, Jowai, u la Yathuh ha une u Nongthoh ba shisien katba ki dang Ya leit siat mrad sha khlaw, ynda poi ha ka iwei i shnong rit, ki la Ya rung ban dih sha ha iwei i dukan iba don harud lynti bad ha kata ka por ki la Yohi ba ki Hati ki don ha trai u lum. Uwei u khynnah samla u la kren beift Ya uwei u Hati ba don hangta ha trai lum. Hynrei, tang hadien katto katne por uta u Hati u la poi ha ka jaka ba uta u khynnah bad ki paralok jong u ki don. Uta u Hati u la shim beit tang Ya uta u khynnah samla uba kren beift Ya u, bad u la lynthaw Ya u ha madan bad u sa Yuh Ya u na shadem bad u la Yap hashen. Namarkata, kynmaw, ba ka long ka bym bit bad kaba shyrkhei ban tim sih tim sang ne ban krein beift Ya ki Hati. Ki Hati ki long ruh ki mrad kiba sngewnguh bha Ya kito kiba lehbha Ya ki. Shisien, la kham slem bha mynta, ka la jia ha kawei ka jaka ba ki khot “Tashi-Nangla” kaba don hajan ka shnong Jrikyndeng. Ka Tashi-Nangla ka dei ka pynthor kba jong uwei u Bhoi uba kyrteng u Sar Milik. Harud kane ka pynthor, shisien, ka la don ka jingYaleh kaba jur bha hapdeng uwei u Hati bad uwei u Bseifl Wyrli-tylle ne u Bseifl Rali-tylle kaba la neh shi sngi tarn. Hapoh kata ka por, uta u Hati man ka por u la pah “Kreng-shi-Kreng” namar ba uta u Bseifl ula khum Ya u bad u Yaleh ban ring Ya u shalade. Haba u Hati u seibor bad tan Ya u Bseifl, u Bseifl u rit ria (Kaba phylla ka long ba ka met jong uta u Bseifl haba tan ka jrong kum haba tan Ya ka jri). Ha ka sngi kaba bud, u Sar Milik, dangstep u leit peit Ya ka lyngkha jong u, bad u la lap ba kata ka jingpah jong uta u Hati ka dei ba u shah tan ha u Bseifl. Kumta ha ka por ba u Hati u tan Ya u Bseifl bad ka met jong u ka la rit ria kat u pipe umkor rit, dei hamar kane ka por ba u Sar Milik u la pom bthat Ya uta u Bseifl bad u la dkut thui ar lyngkhot. Hamar kata hi 21 K1HATI ka por, uta u Hati ula kyllon kram ha madan. Nangta u la khie bad u la beh Ta u Sar Milik bad ynda u la Yoh Ya u, u la shim bad buh Ya u halor ka met jong u bad u la leit buh Ya u Sar Milik sha ka myndo (Ka fingtrep) jong u Sar Milik. Ha baroh kata ka por u la kyiuh bad sheptieng bha, namar u la mut ba uta u Hati un sa pynYap Ya u. Hynrei, ha baroh ka por kba jong kata ka snem uta u Hati u la ap Ya kata ka lyngkha jong u Sar Milik, bad u la beh Ya kiwei pat ki Hati bad ki mrad khlaw kiba la wan bad mut ban bam kba na kata ka lyngkha. Ynda la dep ot Ya u kba, uta u Hati u la leit sha ka Myndo ha kaba u Sar Milik u dang shoh kba bad u la rah shajrong Ya la u luta, ban pynpaw Ya ka dak ka jingsngewnguh jong u Ya u Sar Milik, namar, ba u la pyllait im Ya u.

Naduh kata ka por uta u Hati katba u dang im, man la ka snem ha ka por kba u la leit ap Ya kata ka lyngkha jong u Sar Milik. “Ki Hati ki long ki mrad kiba sngewthuh bha Ya ka jingYap, haba ki lap ha khlaw Ya ka met Yap, ne Ya ki shyieng ki shruh jong ki Hati ba la Yap ki ju lyniar sngewsih”. fa kane ka bynta, une u nongthoh u la Yohi ha ka por ba u la peit Ya ka film kaba kyrteng, “ The Great Elephant Ha ka pyrthei baroh kawei, dei sa tang ha ka dewbah Africa bad ha ka dewbah Asia ba ki Hati ki dang Yaid dang Yeng haduh mynta. “Ki Hati Africa ki Yapher pat na ki Hati Asia ha kane ka rukom: Ki Hati Africa ki kham heh kham jrong bad ka met ka phad jong ki, ka kham wan dur - wan dar bha. Ki shkor jong ki ruh ki long kiba kham heh bad kham wandur wandar bha. Ha ki artylli ki kjat ba shakhmat jong ki, don saw tylli ki tyrsim kjat bad mar lai tylli ki tyrsim kjat ha ki kjat ba shadien jong ki. Ha kliar u luta jong ki, don ar tylli ki rymmiang shyntur. Katba, ki Hati Asia pat ki kham rit khyndiat bad ka met ka phad jong ki ruh ka kham kdor pyrkung. Ki shkor jong ki ruh ki kham rit. Hynrei ki don pat haduh san tylli ki tyrsim kjat ha kawei pa kawei ka kjat ba shakhmat jong ki bad saw tylli ki tyrsim ha kawei pa kawei na ki kjat ba shadien jong ki. Katba ha kliar u luta jong ki pat don tang kawei ka rymmiang shyntur. Ha kajuh ka por, ki Hati Asia kynthei kim ju mih bniat kumba mih bniat ki Hati Africa kynthei”. fa kane ka jingYapher ki Hati Africa bad ki Hati Asia, une u nongthoh u la Yohi bad Yohsngew Ya ka jingbatai ha kawei na ki Programme ba la pyni ha ka Discovery Channel lyngba ka Television. Lada phi hap ban leit jingleit lyngba ka khlaw da ka kjat ne shong da ki kali ha ki lynti khlaw ba dang don bun ki Hati, kynmaw ba lada phi Yakynduh ha lynti ba ki Hati ki dem ha surok ne ha ka lynti ba phi dei ban laid, ong kumne, “Peit shane, ngi khlem wan shane da kaba thmu ban pynsniew ne Yaleh pyrshah Ya phi, hynrei, ngi Yaid la ka jong ka lynti ban pyndep Ya la ki kam ki duk. Namarkata, sngewbha pyllait lynti Ya ngi khnang ba ngin leit”. Tang hadien katto katne por u Hati ne ki Hati kin Yeng da kaba rah ruh Ya la ki luta bad pah kreng kreng bad Yaid noh sha kiwei pat ki jaka. U Bah L.T. Sangma, uba ju long E.A.C. ha ka ophis jong u S.D.O. (Civil) Amlarem Sub - Division , u la Yathuh ha une u Nongthoh, ba. don ki Garo kiba lah ban kylla Hati kumba don ki briew kiba lah ban kylla khla. Lada jia ba phi shah beh ha u Hati, bret da ka rumar ne da kano kano ka jaifl balieh ha khyndew, bad da kaba leh kumta kan pyllait im Ya phi. Namar, u Hati un pynhiar kput Ya ka jingdom jong u ha kata ka jaifl. Hynrei, lada phim don jaifl ban bret, mareh sted, tangba wat march beit. Hadien ba phi la march katto katne, phai noh sha ka diang ne ka mon, da kaba march kumne u Hati un ym lah ban Yoh Ya phi namar, ba shisien u la march sted un ym lah ban phai kynsan kynsan sha ka mon ne sha ka diang. Ki Hati ki long ki mrad kiba don ha tmier ka jingduh jaid.

Ym tang kiba don ha ka dewbah Asia, hynrei kiba don ha ka dewbah Africa ruh, namar, ki nongkhaYi tuh Ya ki bniat Hati ki leit ban siat bad pynYap klep Ya ki kat shaba ki don. Mynta, ha Africa bad ha Asia, ki Hati ki la duna bha 22 Kl MRAD KHLAW KA MEGHALAYA haduh katta katta. Kane ka la pynlong Ya ki dkhot jong ka World Wildlife Fund \ ban ai jingYarap pisa khnang ban dup lah ban pynneh pynsah bad tyngkai Ya ki Hati bad Ya kiwei pat ki mrad kiba don ha tinier jong ka jingduh jaid. Ki Hati ki long ki mrad Ta kiba la khang pyrshah da ka aift ba ym bit ban pynYap Ya ki (Prohibited Animals). Ka jingpyndonkam bad ka jingmyntoi ba ngi Yoh na ki Hati: - fa ki Hati ha ka por hyndai, la pyndonkam Ya ki ha kaba Yaleh thma. Ki syiem India haba ki leit Yaleh thma ki ju shong halor ki Hati. Ka shyntur jong ki ka long kaba lam nep. Hapoh ka shyntur jong ki don ki bniat kiba heh, ba eh, ba khlaifl bad ba nep bha. U thyiliej jong ki u long uba jrong bha, ia uba ki pyndonkam ban jliah ia ki Kruift bad ki Khfliang ba kin dup ioh ban bam. U tdong jong ki u long uba lyngkot bha, uba shu mih tang tiak kumba long kiwei pat ki Dngiem. Ki kjat jong ki ki long kiba ksah, ba khlain bad don san tylli ki shympriahkjat ha kawei pa kawei ka kjat jong ki. Ha baroh ki shympriahkjat jong ki ruh, ha ka bynta ba nalor mih ki tyrsim kiba eh, ba jrong, ba khlain, ba lam kdor bad ba nep bha. la ka met jong ki Dngiem Sngi la sop Ta ka da u shfiiuh ba rben, ba khah, ba khaifi, ba jwat bad ba iong tlem ka rong. Ki pynlut ruh bun ka por halor ki dieng. Ki ju thaw ruh Ya ki skum ha khap ki tnad dieng kiba KJ MRAD KHLAW KA MEGHALAYA bch, da ki tnad dieng barit bad ki sla dieng. Ha ka por sngi ki thiah ha khap ki tnad dieng ba hch ne ha ki skum ba ki la shna. Ki leit wad jingbam ha ka por miet, ki bam bha to ki khftiang ba bun jaid kum Ta ki Kruin, ki Kber bad kiba kum kita ki jaid khniang . Kj bam ruh i’a ki jaid Khnai ba bun jaid, to ki mrad ba rit, ki bam ruh to ki ftiangbshiah, Ki ftiangblen, ki ISfiangbliar, to ka umngap. umlwai, ia ki bynta bajem jong ki dieng tlai, to ka kait bad ia ki soh khlaw ba bun jaid. Ki Dngiem Sngi ruh ki shah siat pyniap ha ki briew namar ba kin dup Toh i'a u Ksang jong ki bad die rem dor to u sha ki Kobiraij. Ki Dngiem Sngi ki iapoikha kumba Tapoikha kiwei pat ki jaid Dngiem. Ka por punkhun jong ki ruh ka long phra bnai tarn. Ki kha khun ruh ar ne lai tylli shisien kha. Ha ka por kha, ki khun ki long ki bym pat lah ban peit khmat bad ki long kiba lyngkhuid khlem shfiiuh. Hadien katto katnc sngi ki sa lah ban peit khmat bad u shfiiuh ba sop ia ka met jong ki ruh u la sdang ban jrong. Ki ju kha khun ruh hapoh ki thliew ba don hapoh khyndew. Ki ri khun ruh hapdcng shisnem tam bad ar snem duna, kumba long kiwei pat ki jaid Dngiem ka kmie ka dei ka nongn nongsumar, ka nongbsa nongpjah bad ka nongpynheh pynsan ia la ki khun. Haba ki khun ki la sngewkhlaifi. ba ki la lah ban im marwei, ki iaid noh la ka lynti bad kim shong kim sah shuh bad la ka kmie.

Ia ki Dngiem Sngi la lap ba ki don ha Meghalaya. Ki don ruh sha kiwei pat ki jylla jong ka ri India bad sha kiwei de ki ri. Ka jingmyntoi ba ngi ioh na ki Dngiem Sngi. Ki Dngiem Sngi ki bam bha ia ki Khniang bad ki Khnai ba bun jaid, kumta ki don ka bynta kaba khraw ha kaban khanglad ba ki Khnai bad ki Khniang kin nym ioh lad ban roi shaba palat. Ia u Ksang jong ki Dngiem Sngi, ki Kobiraij ki shna dawai da kaba khleh lang bad ki kymbat dawai khnang ban sumar ia ki nongpang. la ka khlcin jong ki pat ki pyndonkam ban sumar to ki briew ba pang-mat. Ki briew ki bam ruh ia ka doh jong ki. 119 KlSURI Lynnong 14 KI SURI Ki dei ki jaid mrad i'a kiba la tip ha ka ktien Jaintia kum ki Sun hi. Ki Biate ki khot i'a ki ki Inia. Haba ki la san pura bha. ka khlich bad ka met jong ki ka jrong 3 phut tarn. Ha kaba ieng naduh ka sla kjat ba shakhmat haduh ka tyrpeng jong ki, ki jrong 2 phut tarn. Ka shadem jong ki ka long kaba heh. Ki kjat jong ki baroh saw tylli ki long kiba ksah bad ba khlain bha. Ha ka bynta ba shadien jong ki kjat jong ki don ki thnat kumba long ha ki Ksew ba don thnat. fa ka met jong ki Suri bah la sop da u shniuh uba jlih, ba khah bad nalor ka met ha ka bynta ba don u budlum la sop da u shniuh ba i'ong phyrnai ba long kum u lain. Ia ka bynta jong ki krung, poh ryndang, shadem bad ki kjat la sop da u shniuh ba long lam byrsaw bthuh ka rong. Ia ka bynta naneng ryndang, ki tyrpeng bad Ibong la sop da u shniuh ba i'ong ka rong bad da u shniuh ba lam byrsaw bthuh ka rong. Ia ka bynta jong ka khmat la sop da u shniuh ba lam byrsaw bthuh, i'a ka shyllangmat pat la sop da u shniuh ba lam byri'ong. la ka kpoh la sop da u shniuh ba lam byrsaw lieh. Ia u tdong la sop da u shniuh ba kham jrong ba da ka rong i'ong bad ba lam byrsaw bthuh, ka kliar jong ki tdong ka long kaba i'ong. Ki Suri ba kham rit ki don ka dur ka dar kaba long kum ki Suri bah hi. Ka khlieh bad ka met jong ki ka jrong 2 phut tarn. Haba ki ieng naduh ka slajat haduh ka tyrpeng jong ki, ki jrong 2 phut. Ha baroh ki liang lait noh ha ka jingheh bad ka rong ki long thik kum ki Sun bah hi. Ia ka met jong ki la sop da u shniuh ba long lam byrsaw bthuh ka rong hynrei, u shniuh ba i'ong ruh u mih hi katto katne ha ka met jong ki. Ki Suri ki long ki mrad kiba im ha ka kynhun. Ka kynhun jong ki Suri bah ka long hapdeng 4 bad 8 tylli. Hynrei, la ju Yohi ruh ba ki ia said tang artylli ruh, lehse haba ia'iaid kumne ar tylli ne shijur 120 K» MRAO KHLAW KA MEGHALAYA ka long ba ki Ta luh samla. Ka kynhun jong ki Suri ba kham rit pat ka long kaba kham heh hapdeng 10 bad 20 tylli. Ki Sun ki long ki mrad kiba bam Ya ka doh jong kiwei pat ki mrad, ki bam fa ki mrad kiba heh bad kiba rit ruh kum juh. Tangba bunsien hi ki beh thong Ya ki mrad ba kham heh khnang ba kin dup Yoh ban Tabam lang. U Bah Dwor Mukhim u la iathuh ha une u Nongthoh ba ha ka snem 1964 u la Icit siat mrad sha shilliang jong ka wah Mynkhen lem bad ki paralok jong u lai ngut. Ynda ki la klan sha shiliang ka wah Mynkhen tang hapdeng shiteng kynta ei ei ba ki la i'aid, ki la Yohsngew Ta ka jingkahait jong ki Suri kiba don hapdeng 15 bad 20 tylli ba ki dang Yabeh thong Ta uwei u Bthong uba la san pura bha. Dei hangne ba ki la iohi ba ki Suri ki long ki mrad kiba stad, ba tbit bad ba shemphang bha ban beh mrad. U nongialam kita ki Suri 1cm bad saw tylli kiba bud Ta u, ki la Ta mareh sled shakhmat bad ynda poi ha ka jaka ba don ki phlang ba jrong ki la Ya kynshait da ka urn pynjhieh jong ki Ta kita ki phlang.

Ki Suri ba bun pat ki Yaleh ban khangkdong Ya uta u Bthong, ba un poi sha kata ka jaka ba don ki phlang, ba la dep kynshait umpynjhieh. Tang hadien shiphang uta u Bthong u la poi ha kata ka jaka bad mar Yadei umpynjhieh ki khmat jong uta u Bthong u la long kum uba matlah, bad ki sa Yoh ban dait Ya u da kaba suk, don kiba dait na ki kjat. don kiba dait na ryndang bad na baroh ki bynta ba long ban dait Ya u. Ha kane ka por uta u Bthong u la pynmih ka jingud bad jinglynftiar kaba sngew pangnud ban sngap. Bad da ka jingiadait lang jong kita ki Suri, tang hadien shipor uta u Bthong u la kyllon bad Yap noh. Mar Ya kyllon Yap u Bthong, u Bah Dwor bad ki paralok jong u laingut, ki la beh Ya kita ki suri da kaba hylla bad rah ruh Ya la ki suloi. Ki suri ruh ki kynriah bad ap kham harud khyndiat. U Bah Dwor u sei Ta ka wait tukri jong u bad ot Ta kawci ka Ibong jong uta u Bthong bad rah Ta ka. U tang shu la kham jngai khyndiat, kita ki suri ki la wan biang bad bam Ya ka doh jong uta u Bthong. Ki Suri lada ki don tang ar tylli bad ia kynduh Ta ka mrad ba heh kum Ta ka Masi ne ka Sier, uwei na ki u kynthih halor met jong kata ka miad bad dait na ka hew cit jong ka, bad Yaleh ban Yoh phmng Ya ka khlieh jong u shapoh kata ka mrad, khnang ba un Yoh dait Ya ki doh jem bad kumta kata ka mrad kan kyllon bad Yap kloi. Kiba la iohi Ya kane ka rukom dait mrad ki Suri, ki iathuh ba ynda u Suri u sei Ya ka khlieh jong u, ka long kaba itriem ban peit namar, ka khlieh uta u Sun ka la saw haift da ka snam jong kata ka mrad bad ka dur jong u ka i dakait bad runar bha. Namarkata, wat la ki ju don bun ha kylleng ka Meghalaya bad ha kiba bun ki bynta ka pyrthei, kumba 80 snem mynshwa hynrei, kumba long mynta pat, ki la duna bha ha kylleng satlak ka pyrthei. Ki Suri baroh ar jaid ki Yapoikha kumba Yapoikha ki Ksew, tangba ha ka jingiapoikha jong ki kam ju Taneh-sah bad slem kumba long ki Ksew. Ka por punkhun jong ki ka long 2 bnai tarn. Ki ju kha khun ruh hapdeng 4 bad 6 tylli. Ha ka por kha, ki khun ki long ki bym pat lah ban peit khmat. Ki sa lah ban peit khmat ynda ki la don kham bun sngi. Ki ju kha khun ruh hapoh ki thliew ki krem ba la don lypa ha ka mariang ne ha ki thliew ba ki la tih hi, da kaba kboh da ki shynpriahkjat bad tyrsim jong ki. Haba ki leit beh mrad lang bad ki khun jong ki, kata ka kynhun Suri ka i kumba ka don aijaid ki Suri, kiba heh bad kiba rit.

Kumta ki briew ki bym tip bha Ta ka jinglong jong ki Suri ki mut ba kito ki khun Suri ba ki talam ban beh mrad, ki dei ki Ksew jong ki Suri. U Bah Kynia Beh u la Tathuh ba ha ka snem 1960, ha ka por ba u leit siat mrad, u la ‘iohi Ta ka jingTakhun hapdeng u ‘La Kyrwang bad ka kynhun Suri kaba don hapdeng 25 tylli ne 20 tylli. Namar ba ki Tabun, u Khla wat la u heh bad khlaih bor ruh, urn lah ban leh ei ei. Haba u mut ban dait Ta uwei kiwei pat ki dait Ta u. Ki don ruh hapoh ka Nongkhyllem Reserved Forest , hapoh ka Umsaw Reserved Forest , sha ka lawbah lawsan ba don hapoh ka Narpuh Elaka bad sha kiwei kiwei de ki jaka. La lap ruh ba ki Suri ki don sha kiwei pat ki jylla jong ka Ri India bad ha kiba bun ki ri jong ka pyrthei. Kumta ki don ka bynta kaba khraw ban khang lad Ta ka jingroi ba sha palat than jong ki mrad ki mreng ba bun jaid bun sker. 122 Lynnong 15 K1 PYRBHEW Kl MRAD KHLAW KA MEGHALAYA Ki dei ki jaid mrad ba la tip ha ka ktien Jaintia kum ki Bhew, sha thaift Mawpat ki khot la ki, ki Phirew. bhew pyr... bhew pyr.. bhew", bad dei na ka rukom jlew jong ki ba ki Khasi ki sa khot ia ki, ki Pyrbhew. Ki kjat jong ki, ki long kiba khlaifi bad ki lah ban mareh sted. Ha ki shympriahkjat jong ki, mih ki tyrsim kiba eh, ba khlaifi bad ba long tylli kum ki tyrsnn Ksew. Ha ka bynta ba shadien jong ki kjat jong ki pat don ki thnat. Ia ka bynta ba nalor ka met jong ki, la sop da u shfiiuh uba i'ong bad ba lam byrtem. la ka bynta jong ka khmat bad ka shyntur la sop da u shfiiuh ba bthuh lam byrtem. la ka bynta ba napoh ryndang, ka shadem, ki krung, ka kpoh bad ki kjat la sop da u shfiiuh ba bthuh lam byrtem. Ka bynta ba nalor ryndang bad Ta ki Ibong pat la sop da u shfiiuh ba Vong bad ba lam byrtem bthuh, ka kliar jong u tdong ka long kaba i'ong ka rong. Ki pyrbhew ki bam i'a ka meti'ap jong kiwei pat ki mrad. Ki bam wat ia ka doh kaba sma iwtung ruh. Kumta ki long ki nongpynkhuid i'a ka pyut ka pyar. Ki bam ruh i'a ki sim kum ki *Iar khlaw, ‘Iar tung, ‘Iar khiar, ki Tyut bad kiba kum kita ki jaid sim i’a kiba ki lah ban ioh. U Bah Kynia Beh uba long u Rangbah Shnong jong ka Shnong Moothadae, kaba don ha ka jaka ba Yakhajia pud bad ka jylla Assam bad Meghalaya, uba long ruh u Kobiraij badonnam bad uba tbit bha ban siat mrad, u la iathuh ha une u Nongthoh ba ki Pyrbhew ki long kiba sian bha, ki ju bud kham na jngai ia u Khia bad ynda u Khia u la ioh mrad bad hadien ba u la dep bam bad leit phai sha ka jaka ba u sah, ki sa bam i’a ka doh kaba tarn ia kaba u Khia urn lah ban bam pynlut, bad ynda ki la kdang ki sa leit phai sha ka jaka ba ki shong ki sah.

Ki Pyrbhew ki tapoikha kumba iapoikha ki Suri. Ka por punkhun jong ki, ka long ar bnai tarn bad ki ju kha khun hapdeng 4 bad 6 tylli. Ha ka por kha, ki khun ki long ki bym pat peit khmat. Haba la kha ’ia i khun, i tang shu san i la dei ban mih noh bad iehnoh Ta la ki kmie ki kpa, bad i hap ban lap nc wad Ta la u ne ka nongsumar ban Ta shong lasah ryngkat, baroh shirta. Ki Huleng ym tang ba ki long kiba tbit ban kicw dieng hynrci, ki long ruh kiba tbit ban rynsied, ban ryngkang. ban ryngkoh bad ban kynthih na kawei ka tnad dieng sha kawei pat. hynrei uba ki lah hi ban ryngkoh ban poi sha u, khnang ba kata ka jingryngkoh jong ki kan long kaba khlaift, ki ju bat pynskhem ha kawei ka tnad dieng da kawei ka kti jong ki, bad ki sa pynpawang Ta kata ka tnad dieng bunsien ba kan shad pyllun pyllun, haba la jur bha ka jingpawang, ki sa pyllait Ta la ka kti bad ki long kumba her ha ka jingsted kaba jur, bad da ki kti ba jrong jong ki. ki bat ha ki tnad dieng jong uta uwei u dieng, da kaba lah ban leh kumne ki lait ban hiar sha khyndew. khnang ban kiew Ta uta u dieng. Haba ki la san pura bha, ka lynter jong ka khlieh bad ka met jong ki ka jrong shi pruh tam. Ki Shrieh Heh kynthei ki kham rit khyndiat ban ia ki shynrang. Ka khlich jong ki ka long kaba pyllun bad ba heh. Ki shkor jong ki, ki long kiba i'eng kum ki shkor bricw, kiba rit bad bymdon shniuh. Namarkata, sha ki jaka ba don kinc ki jaid Shrieh. ki kynthei haba ki leit sha ki iew ki hat ne sha ki bri ki lyngkha, ki ju i'a leit ryngkat bad ki rangbah, khnang ba ki Shrieh Heh kin nym nud ban wan hajan jong ki. U Bah S.G. Moinin u la thoh sha une u Nongthoh, ba ki Shrieh Heh ki long kiba khlain bha, bad ki lah wat ban rah i'a u Ksew shalor dieng, bad sa bret nc pynhap ia u sha khyndew, khnang ba un dup Yap. Ki lah wat ban ryngkoh lane rynsied na uwci u dieng sha uwei pat, lada kita ki dieng ki Yadon maijan. Ki long ruh kiba sted ban i’aid ha madan madiah bad ba tbit ban jngi. Thaiang pat, u la iathuh ba u Nongi'alam jong ki, u dei u Jha, uba long u Shrieh uba heh tarn bad ba khlain tarn hapoh kata ka knah. Ki Shrieh Heh ki im da kaba bam Ta ki soh khlaw ba bun jaid, ia ki syntiew jong ki katto katne ki jaid dieng, i’a ki sla dieng, ki shylluid jong ki jingthung ba mih ha khyndew, kum ka lungsiej bad kiba kum kita. Ki bam ruh ia ki khfiiang ki ksiah ba bun jaid bunsker. Ki bang bha ban bam i’a ki kber bad ia ki thapbawa. Hadien katto katne por, ki leit wad jingbam biang, haduh shwa ban kem Tongrein. Mar Ta wan ka prem-miet ki leit phai noh, sha u dieng ba ki ju sah miet. Ki thiah ki dem ruh halor ki tnad dieng, kiba don kham sha kliar jong ki diengbah, khnang ba ki mrad kiba mut ban bam Ta ki, kum ki Khla kin nym Toh ne lait ban kiew sha ka jaka ba ki thiah ki dem. U Bah Bniah Lathong u la Tathuh ba ki Shrieh Heh, teng teng ki ju Tapoikha hakhap jong ki tnad dieng ba heh jong ki diengbah, da kaba thiah kum ki briew. Hynrei, barabor ki 'iapoikha da dien kumba iapoikha ki Phyllad. Ki kha khun iwei shisien kha. Ka por ri khun jong ki ka long hapdeng shi snem bad shi snem tarn. Naduh ba la kha Ta i khun, ka kmie ka Talam Ta i kat shaba ka leit, da kaba rah Ta i khun halor ka shadem jong ka. Haba i khun i la kham san bad i la khlain bha, ka ju bah Ta i halor ka met jong ka. Dei ruh ha ka por ba ki ri khun, ba ki khun ki sa tip ban jied Ta kino ki jaid soh khlaw bad ki jaid khhiang kiba bit ban bam. Ki Shrieh Heh kynthei bad kiwei pat ki jaid Shrieh ruh, ki don ar tylli ki jymbuifi halor ka shadem jong ki, kaba long kham pher na ka rukom ba don ki jymbuiii jong kiba bun ki mrad ki mreng. Ka kmie ka pyllut ruh bun ka por ban Tit ksi Tit thyllah Ta la i khun. Ki Shrieh Heh ba la san ruh, ki ju Ta Tit ksi Tit thyllah mar kylhang para maki. Ki Shrieh Heh bad kiwei pat ki jaid Shrieh ruh, kim lah ban shah Ta ka jingsma jong ka tungrymbai, ba kan bit ha ka met jong ki. Ha ka por ba une u Nongthoh u dang khynnah, u la Tohi ba don ba ai tungrymbai ba la song hapoh ka sla, Ta uwci u Shrieh ba la ri da u Bah Kei Laloo (Bam kwai ha dwar u Blei) ha ka por ba u dang shong hapoh ka dong Mission Compound, Jowai ha ka Ting barim (tangba mynta la dep shna thymmai Ta ka da ka Ting dewbilat ha kaba ka don ka Tax ophis jong ka Sorkar Meghalaya ka la pynlong ophis mynta).

Uta u Shrieh u la law Ta kata ka jingsong, bad u la ktah Ta kata ka tungrymbai. Hynrei, u tang shu iw Ta la ka kti bad Tohsngew Ta ka jingsma jong kata ka tungrymbai, u la kyrshut Ta la ka kti ha uwei u maw, ba don ha ka jaka ba la teh Ta u. Nangta u iw biang Ta la ka kti, bad shem ba kata ka jingsma tungrymbai ka dang sah. Kumta u Tai trud Ta la ka kti bad Tai kyrshut Ta ka haduh ban da mih snam. Wat la katta ruh kata ka jingsma kam jah satia. Kumta u Tai trud bad Tai kyrshut Ta la ka kti ha uta u maw, bad ka snam ka nang mih na ka kti jong u. Hadien katto katne sngi, uta u Shrieh u Tap noh. Dei na kane ka jingTohi ba une u Nongthoh u la pyrkhat ba Ichse ba baroh ki jaid Shrieh, lada kan bit ka tungrymbai ha ka met jong ki bad Tohsngew Ta ka jingsma jong ka, kin leh kumjuh kumba la leh uto u Shrieh ba la ri u Bah Kei Laloo. Hynrei, Ta kane ka bynta dang dei ban leh experiment shuh, khnang ban pynthikna ba ka long kumba la thoh haneng. Namar, ka lah ban long ba uta u Shrieh urn lah ban shah Ta ka jingsma jong ka tungrymbai ban neh ha ka met jong u, katba kiwei pat Ichse ki lah ban shah. U Bah Biren Pde u la Tathuh ba kumba 40 ne 45 snem mynshwa, ki Shrieh kiba heh, hynrei um lah ban ong la ki dei ki Shrieh Heh ne em, ki dang bun bad jyllei bha sha thain Mupiah, kaba don hajan Shnong Jowai. Ha kawei ka sngi u la Tohi ba ki Shrieh kiba don ha ka knah ne ka kynhun kaba hapdeng 15 bad 20 tylli, kaba don hapoh ka jingialam jong uwei u Shrieh uba heh tarn bad ba khlain tarn jong kata ka knah. Ynda u nongTalam jong ki u la ryngkoh shapoh ka wah Myntdu, bad sdang ban jngi sha shilliang jong ka, baroh kita ki Shrieh ba don hapoh kata ka knah, ki la Taryngkoh shapoh ka wah Myntdu uwei hadien uwei pat, bad jngi sha shilliang jong kata ka wah. Hynrei, mynta la bun snem, ym don Shrieh shuh ha kane ka thain namarba ki briew ki siat pynTap Ta ki, khnang ban Toh ban bam Ta ka doh jong ki. Ha ka por ba une u Nongthoh u dang khynnah, u la Tohi bad kynmaw ba don ki Shrieh ba ju poi ha ka khlaw, ba don hajan ka Jowai Civil Hospital . Ki pynjot bad pynjulor bha 7a ka rep ka riang bad ka thung ka tep jong ki briew. Kumta ki briew ki siat pynTap Ta ki, khnang ban Tada la ka rep ka riang bad Ta ka thung ka tep jong ki, bad ban Toh ruh ban bam Ta ka doh ba bang jong ki. Mynta la bun snem, ym ju lap Shrieh shuh sha kane ka thaift. Kumba 40 ne 50 snem mynshwa. lah ban ong ba ki Shrieh bad kiwei pat ki jaid mrad, ki dang jyllei bha ha kylleng ki jaka ba don hapoh u pud u sam jong ka jylla Meghalaya. Hynrei, kumba long mynta kiba bun ki mrad, ki don ha tmier jong ka jingduh jaid. Namarkata, baroh ki nongshongshnong jong ka jylla Meghalaya, ki dei ban iatrei lang bad ka Sorkar, khnang ban dup lah ban pynneh pynsah bad tyngkai Ta baroh ki jaid mrad khlaw, kiba dang don hapoh ka jylla Meghalaya, na ka bynta ka jingmyntoi jong ngi hi bad jong ki longdien ruh kumjuh. Ha Meghalaya, la lap ba ki Shrieh Hch ki don ha ki katto katne ki khlaw, ba don ha Gam Hills.

Ki don ruh ha ki katto katne ki khlaw ba don ha Khasi Mills. Ha Jaintia Hills, la lap ba ki dang kham bun hapoh ki khlaw, ba don harud ki phud wah jong ka wah Kupli, hapoh ki khlaw ba don hapoh Saipung Sirdarship bad ha ki khlaw ba don hapoh ka hlaka Labang Nongphyllut. Balei ki Shrieh ki pynjot bad pynjulor, Ta ka rep ka riang bad ka thung ka tep jong u khun bynriew? Katkum ka jingiathuhkhana pateng jong ki newtymmen, ki Shrieh ki pynjot bad pynjulor bha ia ka rep ka riang bad ka thung ka tep jong u khun bynriew narnar, shisien ka sngi ha ka por mynbarim. u khun bynriew u la shet kylla ia u Jha ne u nongialam jong ki Shrieh Heh, katkum kane ka jingi’athuh khana harum: Ha ka por hyndai hynthai, kulong kumah, mynba u briew bad ki laiphcw mrad laiphew mreng ki dang i'akren Takhana. Ha kata ka por ka la jia ka nemsniew kaba }ur bha ha kawei ka Shnong kaba don hapoh ka Elaka Nongkhlieh jong ka Jaintia Hills District. Kumta, narnar ba jur than ka jingkyrduh jingbam, ki briew jong kata ka Shnong kim banse shuh ban dung khaw wat Ta u kba symbai (Ta uba ki la buh tyngkai kyrpang khnang ba kin dup ioh ban bet, ha u snem uba bud) khnang ban lait na ka jingiap thngan. Kumta ha u snem uba bud, ha shwa ka por ban rep kba, ki briew kata ka Shnong ki la leit ban pan kba symbai kylliang, na ki Shnong kiba maijan. Hynrei kita ki trai Shnong ba marjan ruh ki ong, “Ba ngim nud ban ai Ta phi namar ba ngi sheptieng, ba ka nemsniew ruh ka lah ban jia ha ka shnong jong ngi". Hadien kata, u rangbah Shnong jong kata ka Shnong, ha kaba la jia kata ka nemsniew, u la khot Ta ka jingTalang ba kyrkieh jong ka Dorbar Shnong. Ha ka miet ba long kata ka Dorbar Shnong, ynda baroh ki rangbah ki la Tapoi lut, uta u Rangbah Shnong u la Teng bad ong, “Kumba phi la Tatip Ta ka jingeh ba don hakhmat jong ngi. Kumta nga khot Ta phi ban i'akren, ban Ta tuklar bad ban Ta ai jingmut, kumno ngin Taleh ne ba ngin hap ban Taphet Shnong noh shawei". Hangta la Teng uwei u rangbah bad u la iathuh, “Nga la i'ohi ba ha lyndet kawei ka khlaw, kaba jngai ku mba 15 mail na kane ka shnong jong ngi, ba don ka lyngkha kaba heh bad ba Tar bha, ha kaba u kba u la seisoh bha bad u la ih stem bha, ha ka por ba nga la Tohi Ta kata ka lyngkha. Kumta nga ai jingmut, ba ngi dei ban leit pan kba symbai kylliang noh na ki trai jong kata ka lyngkha”. U la Tathuh ruh ba don kawei ka jingeh ban leit sha lyndet jong kata ka khlaw namar, hapoh kata ka khlaw ki don bun bah ki Shrieh Heh kiba shong ba sah hangta. *53 Kl SHRIEH Hadien ba ki la iakren bad la tuklar bha halor kata ka jingai jingmut jong uta u rangbah, ka Dorbar ka la rai da kawei ka jingmut, ba lada jia katba jia, lada long katba long, kin Ta mih 25 ngut ki rangbah ban leit pan kba symbai kylliang, na ki trai kata ka lyngkha kaba don ha lyndet kata ka khlaw. Ha kata hi ka Dorbar ki la jied ia ki 25 ngut ki rangbah, kiban leit pan kba symbai kylliang. Kumta, ha ka sngi ba ki la Ta buh, 25 ngut ki rangbah ki la ia leit sha kata ka jaka ba don kata ka lyngkha. Hynrei, ynda ki la poi hapdeng jong kata ka khlaw la mih ka kynhun ba bun jong ki Shrieb Heh, bad u Jha ne u nongialam jong kita ki Shreih Heh u la kylli, “Phin ia leit shaei kumne?” Uta u Rangbah Shnong u la Tathuh, “Ba ngin Yaleit sha ki trai jong katei ka lyngkha, kaba don ha lyndet jong kane ka khlaw. Namarba jur ka nemsniew ha ka Shnong jong ngi, kumta da ka jingbym banse ngi la hap ban dung khaw wat ia u kba symbai ruh, khnang ban lait na ka jingiap thngan. Kumta ngin ia leit ban pan kba symbai kylliang na ki trai jong katei ka lyngkha kein”. “Katei ka lyngkha kaba don ha lyndet jong kane ka lawbah ka dei ka jong ngi, ia kaba ngi la sumar bha’\ la phai ktien pat uta u nongialam jong ki Shrieh Heh. “Haba kumta nga kyrpad ia phi, ba phin sngewbha ban ai kba symbai kylliang ia ngi. Nga kular ruh ba ynda ngi la dcp ot kba ngin sa wan pynphai bad ai tarn ruh, ia kaba ngi dei ban ai sha phi”, la kyrpad u Rangbah Shnong. “Em, ngam lah ban ai marwei namar, ka lyngkha ka dei ka jong ngi ki Shneh Heh baroh lang. Ap ngan da iakren shwa bad ki para Shrieh jong nga, lada ki shah ban ai ne lada kim shah ban ai ruh, ngan sa iathuh ha phi”, la phai ktien pat u Jha ki Shrieh Heh.

“To” la jubab u Rangbah Shnong. Mar kumta uta u Jha jong ki Shrieh Heh, u la leit kham pajih na kaba don ki briew, bad u la pah kiak-kiak-kiak. bad kita ki Shrieh baroh kiba don hangta ki la i'aleit shaba don u Nongialam jong ki, bad ki la iashong pyllun ia u, kumba ker ia u hapdeng.
